# Tech My School

> Puerto Rico 501(c)(3) education nonprofit. We build technology plans for schools, train teachers, and donate technology so students have a more equitable learning experience.

- Legal name: Tech My School Inc.
- EIN: 66-0996264

## Impact (as stated on techmyschool.org)
- 50+ schools served
- 5,000+ students impacted
- 500+ teachers trained
- 100+ professional development sessions a year
- Schools in 21 Puerto Rico municipalities
- More than $1 million in goods and services donated

## Optional
- Conference: 4th annual Spring Educators EdTech Conference, April 12–13, 2027, Wyndham Grand Rio Mar, Río Grande, Puerto Rico; 50+ speakers (the most recent conference had 500+ attendees and 70+ sessions over two days): https://www.techmyschool.org/conference.html
